Title: Create employee with valid data
Description: Verify creating an employee with valid name, role, and id
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with valid employee JSON containing id, name, and role
Expected Result: Response status 201 Created with employee data in response body and Location header set

Title: Create employee with missing name
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when name is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing name but with id and role
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing role
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when role is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing role but with id and name
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with missing id
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when id is missing
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON missing id but with name and role
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty name
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when name is empty string
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON having empty name and valid id and role
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with empty role
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when role is empty string
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with employee JSON having empty role and valid id and name
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Create employee with null body
Description: Verify creating an employee fails when request body is null
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/employee with null body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'name and role are required to enter'

Title: Get all employees
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns a list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Expected Result: Response contains a list of EmployeeModel objects

Title: Get all employees when no employees exist
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee returns an empty list when no employees exist
Pre-Conditions: No employees exist in the repository
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee
Expected Result: Response contains an empty list

Title: Get employee by valid id
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee/{id} returns employee details when a valid id is provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with a valid existing employee id
Expected Result: Response contains employee details with status 200 OK

Title: Get employee by non-existing id
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee/{id} returns 404 when employee id does not exist
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with a non-existing employee id
Expected Result: Response contains message 'employee not found' with status 404

Title: Get employee with null id
Description: Verify that GET /api/employee/{id} returns 400 when id is null
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Expected Result: Response contains message 'id is required' with status 400

Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns status 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and valid employee data in body
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains updated employee data
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and response body contains updated employee with name 'John Doe', role 'Developer', absent false

Title: Update employee with null id
Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns bad request with message 'id is required'
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null and valid employee data in body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'id is required'
Expected Result: Response status is 400 and response body contains message 'id is required'

Title: Update employee with null request body
Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns bad request with message 'request body is required'
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and null request body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'request body is required'
Expected Result: Response status is 400 and response body contains message 'request body is required'

Title: Update employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify updating employee with id that does not exist returns 404 with message 'employee not found'
Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id and valid employee data in body
Verify response status is 404
Verify response body contains message 'employee not found'
Expected Result: Response status is 404 and response body contains message 'employee not found'

Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns status 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id and partial employee data in body
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains updated fields and unchanged other fields
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and response body contains updated role 'Manager' and other fields unchanged

Title: Delete employee with valid id
Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 status
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the repository
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted

Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with non-existing id returns 404 status with message
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found'

Title: Delete employee with null id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 status with message
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Verify marking batch attendance with valid list of attendance DTOs
Pre-Conditions: AttendanceService and AttendanceRepo are available and functional
Test Steps: Prepare a list of valid AttendanceDTO objects with employeeId and absent fields
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status and body

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Verify response when sending empty list as payload
Pre-Conditions: AttendanceService and AttendanceRepo are available and functional
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as JSON body
Verify response status and error message

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Verify response when sending null as payload
Pre-Conditions: AttendanceService and AttendanceRepo are available and functional
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null as JSON body
Verify response status and error message

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Verify batch marking when some DTOs have missing employeeId or absent fields
Pre-Conditions: AttendanceService and AttendanceRepo are available and functional
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects where some have missing employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status and invalidEntries list

Title: Mark batch attendance with all invalid entries
Description: Verify batch marking when all DTOs are invalid
Pre-Conditions: AttendanceService and AttendanceRepo are available and functional
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects all missing employeeId or absent fields
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as JSON body
Verify response status and invalidEntries list

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent fields returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId and absent
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId and absent
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance data containing employeeId 1 and absent true

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date returns 200 and attendance data
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body containing employeeId, absent and date
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance data with employeeId, absent and date
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance data containing employeeId 1, absent false and date 2024-06-01

Title: Mark attendance with null request body
Description: Verify marking attendance with null request body returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify marking attendance with missing employeeId returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with missing absent
Description: Verify marking attendance with missing absent returns 400 with error message
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with JSON body missing absent
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeId and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeId and absent required'

Title: POST /run with valid body
Description: Verify POST /run returns success with valid request body
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with valid JSON body
Expected Result: Response contains success message

Title: POST /run with empty body
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when request body is empty
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with empty body
Expected Result: Response contains error message for missing body

Title: POST /run with invalid JSON body
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when request body is invalid JSON
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with invalid JSON body
Expected Result: Response contains error message for invalid JSON

Title: POST /run with missing required fields
Description: Verify POST /run returns error when required fields are missing in body
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with JSON body missing required fields
Expected Result: Response contains error message for missing required fields

Title: POST /run with extra unknown fields
Description: Verify POST /run ignores extra unknown fields in request body
Test Steps: Send POST request to /run with valid body plus extra unknown fields
Expected Result: Response is success ignoring unknown fields

Title: Get diff without query parameters
Description: Verify GET /diff returns diff data without any query parameters
Test Steps: Send GET request to /diff without query parameters
Expected Result: Response contains diff data in JSON array format

Title: Get diff with unsupported query parameter
Description: Verify GET /diff returns diff data ignoring unsupported query parameters
Test Steps: Send GET request to /diff with unsupported query parameter ?foo=bar
Expected Result: Response contains diff data ignoring unsupported query parameters

Title: Get diff returns empty array when no diffs
Description: Verify GET /diff returns empty JSON array when there are no diffs
Pre-Conditions: No changes in endpoints or test cases
Test Steps: Send GET request to /diff
Expected Result: Response contains empty JSON array []

Title: Get prompt successfully
Description: Verify that GET /prompt returns the last prompt successfully
Pre-Conditions: A prompt has been generated and stored
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /prompt
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body contains the last prompt string
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body contains the last prompt string

Title: Get prompt when no prompt exists
Description: Verify that GET /prompt returns null or empty when no prompt has been generated
Pre-Conditions: No prompt has been generated or stored
Test Steps: Send a GET request to /prompt
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response body is null or empty
Expected Result: Response status is 200 and body is null or empty
